title: IVG Intense Salts Riberry Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Riberry Lemonade combines the rich taste of Blackcurrant cordial with a fizzy Lemonade base. The result is a flavour that’s full-bodied and juicy, with a tangy citrus lift that keeps it bright and refreshing. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt delivers clear flavour, discreet vapour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices including pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. As part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Riberry Lemonade recreates the familiar taste of a classic soft drink pairing, making it a great choice for vapers who enjoy fruit and soda-inspired blends.
